## Appearance

Sarah is a small person who dresses in shabby black garments. She has a thin face with slender cheeks.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P63](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0063)_

## Personality

By this point, Sarah feels entirely comfortable and happy in her life with [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md). She no longer spends time dwelling on past thoughts or concerns.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Romance P13](../source/v03-c30.md#nw-v03-c30-p0013)_

## History

In her youth, Sarah was timid and frightened of her father, who forced her to give up Luther Wallace twenty years prior because Luther was poor. Years later, after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally fell through the roof of an outhouse while trying to look at a willow-ware platter, Sarah chopped her free. After listening to Anne's explanation, Sarah sold the platter to her for twenty-five dollars, entertained [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) over tea, and shared that she was planning to marry.

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P16](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0016), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P56](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0056), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P62](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0062), +2 more_

## Quotes

> “Miss Copp,” she said earnestly. “I assure you I looked into your pantry window only to discover if you had a willow-ware platter. I didn’t see anything else—I didn’t look for anything else.”
>
> — Sarah — [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P56](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0056)

> "I don’t know as I mind selling the platter. But it’s worth twenty-five dollars. It’s a very old platter."
>
> — Sarah — [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P61](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0061)
